help.snippets:
argvus snippets: type saved text into the focused window.

Usage:
  argvus snippets                      open the picker (SUPER + ALT + N)
  argvus snippets add NAME CONTENT     add a snippet, or replace the one with the same name
  argvus snippets remove NAME          remove a snippet
  argvus snippets list                 print the index and name of every snippet
  argvus snippets open NAME|INDEX      type a snippet into the focused window
  argvus snippets -h, --help           show this help

Exemplo:
  argvus snippets add "email" "you@example.com"
  argvus snippets list
  argvus snippets open email

Os trechos são digitados onde o cursor está, então foque um campo de texto primeiro.
help.git:
argvus-git: abra preguiça (ou gitui) em um projeto que você escolher.

Usage:
  argvus git              pick a project, then open the git TUI in it (SUPER + ALT + G)
  argvus git DIR          open the git TUI in DIR
  argvus git -h, --help   show this help

Exemplo:
  argvus git
  argvus git ~/Projects/api

Defina ARGVUS GIT TUI=gitui para preferir gitui ao preguiça.

help.gpg:
argvus-gpg: gerencia GPG chaves. gpg-agent usa pinentry-gtk, que é configurado automaticamente quando uma chave é gerada.

Usage:
  argvus gpg                                       show this help
  argvus gpg list                                  list the keys as TSV: fingerprint, key id, type, expires, secret, validity, user id
  argvus gpg generate UID [--algo rsa|dsa] [--bits 1024|2048|3072|4096] [--expire 0|2y|YYYY-MM-DD|...]
criar uma chave com uma sub- chave de encriptação; a pinentry pede a frase- senha
  argvus gpg generate UID --passphrase-stdin       read the passphrase from the first line of stdin
  argvus gpg generate UID --no-passphrase --yes    create a key without a passphrase (unprotected)
  argvus gpg export-public ID FILE [--force]       write the public key in ASCII armor; FILE - prints it
  argvus gpg export-private FP FILE --yes          write the private key in ASCII armor, mode 600
  argvus gpg import FILE                           import public keys (private keys are refused)
  argvus gpg import-private FILE                   import a file that holds a private key
  argvus gpg delete FP --yes                       delete a key with its secret part
  argvus gpg edit expire FP 0|2y|YYYY-MM-DD        change the expiry of the key and its subkeys
  argvus gpg edit passwd FP                        change the passphrase (the pinentry asks)
  argvus gpg edit sign FP SIGNER --yes             certify the key with the secret key of SIGNER
  argvus gpg edit revoke FP --reason none|compromised|superseded|unused --yes
  argvus gpg edit trust FP none|marginal|full|ultimate
  argvus gpg keyserver send FP --yes               publish the key to the keyserver of gpg.conf
  argvus gpg keyserver recv FP                     fetch the key from the keyserver
  argvus gpg status                                show the gnupg and pinentry state
  argvus gpg -h, --help                            show this help

Exemplo:
  argvus gpg generate "Your Name <you@example.com>" --expire 2y
  argvus gpg export-public you@example.com ~/public.asc

Chaves privadas são exportadas apenas com --yes. As frases-passe são digitadas na janela pinentry ou enviadas na entrada padrão, nunca passadas como argumentos.

help.keys:
argvus-keys: gerir os pares de teclas SSH e o agente ssh.

Usage:
  argvus keys                              show this help
  argvus keys list                         list the key pairs in ~/.ssh and whether they are loaded
  argvus keys generate NAME [--type ed25519|rsa] [--comment C] [--passphrase]
criar um par de chaves; --passphrase define um num terminal
  argvus keys load NAME                    add the key to the agent (a terminal asks for the passphrase)
  argvus keys unload NAME                  remove the key from the agent
  argvus keys unload-all                   remove every key from the agent
  argvus keys delete NAME                  delete the key pair from ~/.ssh
  argvus keys -h, --help                   show this help

Exemplo:
  argvus keys generate work --comment you@example.com
  argvus keys load work

Chaves nunca são impressas. As frases-passe são digitadas no terminal, nunca passadas como argumentos.
